posts.name: Vishal Kumar
posts.cooked:
I want to the knowledge the process for not eligible for oppe student.

Like I take system command course last term sep-2025 and due to some medical issue. I can’t submit my VM PORTAL BPT. I am absent in BPT. As per OPPE eligibility guidelines I have to score certain marks in BPT for OPPE schedule.

In my case, I don’t have attend bpt and got 0 marks. I give quiz1 and end term successfully.

Now in this term feb-2026, I choose repeat OPPE. Then what is the process. Like, for me VM PORTAL BPT again available separately and give bpt again. Or for VM PORTAL BPT i have to repeat entire SC COURSE.

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: Since you have selected repeat only oppe, you need to submit the BPTs to be eligible for OPPE. But for grading, last term’s BPT scores are carried forward, i.e. 0 in your case.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
23f3003390:

VM PORTAL BPT again available separately and give bpt again

The VM and course access both will be there. But you have to do only BPTs as Mrinal said.
Note -

Mrinal.exe:

But for grading, last term’s BPT scores are carried forward, i.e. 0 in your case.

posts.name: Vishal Kumar
posts.cooked:
Without course registration in this term (repeat oppe). Is I am able to submit BPT again. Deadline for submitting BPT has passed of last term.

Is the bpt available for me. If I open my VM as timeline for SC COURSE is scheduled.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: you can (and should) submit BPTs again this term. Only if you submit and score in BPT can OPPE be scheduled for you. However BPT marks in final score will still remain 0 from last term. I hope this is already clarified by the TAs above.

posts.name: Yash
posts.cooked: I am also repeating oppe only this sem, but I have 100 in all BPTs, so I am supposed to just attend oppe right, skipping BPTs

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
You have to do BPT this term too.

  • Current Term BPT required for OPPE eligibility
  • Previous Term BPT taken for final score calculation

already mentioned thrice above.
